== OVERVIEW ==
A class that battles with the fury of a whirlwind—swift as lightning, invasive as fire, and masters of suppressing enemies with relentless aggression. 

They champion the frontal breakthrough, dominating the battlefield with a tempestuous rhythm of attack, growing even more formidable amidst the heat of close-quarters combat. 

The '''Duelist''' is like a predatory beast on the battlefield, fearless in the face of pain.  With exceptional recovery, they can rapidly stabilize their condition during intense skirmishes. Even when heavily wounded, they rely on indomitable will to launch a desperate counterattack and seize victory from the jaws of defeat. 

Revel in the thrill of dancing upon blades, and crush the enemy's ranks with an overwhelming offensive!
